SPECIAL MEETING AGENDA
CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
MONDAY - DECEMBER 22, 2025 - 07:00 P.M.
CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL CHAMBER
18125 BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CA 90703
Agenda Materials
The complete agenda for this meeting is available on-demand at cerritos.gov and at the Office of the City Clerk, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, 1st floor, Cerritos, CA, during regular business hours (Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., weekend and observed holidays excepted). Any materials submitted to the legislative body after distribution of this agenda will be available for public inspection in the Office of the City Clerk during regular business hours. Requests for agenda materials or meeting participation assistance can also be made by email to city_clerk@cerritos.gov or by phone at (562) 916-1248 during regular business hours.
Order of Agenda
The City Council, by majority of those members present, may reorder the business items listed on the agenda.
PUBLIC OBSERVATION AND PARTICIPATION
The public can observe the meeting via livestream on the City’s website at cerritos.gov, on cable television at Cerritos TV3, or in person in the Council Chamber.
Public Comments
Members of the public may provide public comment for this meeting in person at the meeting or in writing as described below.
In-person public comment : Public comment on business agenda items will be opened and may be provided during consideration of that business agenda item.
Written public comment (hard copy or email) : Public comment may be submitted via email to city_clerk@cerritos.gov or by hard copy to the Office the City Clerk at 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, Cerritos, CA 90703 no later than 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Please identify the agenda item number in the subject line of the email or hard copy document. All written correspondence received by the 3:00 p.m. deadline will be distributed to the legislative body prior to the meeting and retained with the official meeting record.
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodations
In compliance with the ADA, any person with a disability who requires accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the Office of the City Clerk at (562) 916-1248 or at city_clerk@cerritos.gov in advance of the meeting to request accommodation. The City will use its best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations related to the meeting.

MINUTES OF A SPECIAL MEETING OF THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL HELD MONDAY,
DECEMBER 22, 2025, 7:00 P.M., IN THE COUNCIL CHAMBER AT CERRITOS CITY HALL,
18125 BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA.

 1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.

 2.  Invocation

  The invocation was given by Father John Cordero, Holy Family Catholic Church.

 3.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Troop 394.

 4.  Roll Call

  The following members of the City Council were in attendance:

  Councilmember Jennifer Hong
  Councilmember Mark E. Pulido
  Councilmember Sophia M. Tse
  Mayor Pro Tem Lynda P. Johnson
  Mayor Frank Aurelio Yokoyama

 5.  New Business

 5A.  Discussion of the status of the recent critical failure of the C-4 Well, loss of water supply,
  and proposed emergency repair.

  Review and consideration of authorization of budget and contract amendments to
  perform an emergency repair to the C-4 Well (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Alvin Papa, Director of Public Works/City Engineer.

  The Mayor opened the public comments period.

  Raymond Kim spoke regarding research related to decreased pension funding.

  Rogan Girard expressed concern regarding the City’s need to address emergency repairs
  and appropriate levels of staffing.

  Ben Laurin, AFSCME Local 619, expressed support for City Council approval of the
  recommended action for this item.

  Steve Stallings spoke in opposition to proposed water and sewer rate adjustments as
  presented in the City’s Notice of Public Hearing on Proposed Water and Sewer Rate
  Adjustment.

  Sam Desai spoke in opposition to proposed water and sewer rate adjustments as
  presented in the City’s Notice of Public Hearing on Proposed Water and Sewer Rate
  Adjustment.

  Charles Sooter spoke regarding alternate forms of revenue for the City to increase funds.
 City of Cerritos  Monday, December 22, 2025, 7:00 p.m.

5.  New Business (continued)

A.  (continued)

  Kurtis Forsythe spoke in opposition to proposed water and sewer rate adjustments as
  presented in the City’s Notice of Public Hearing on Proposed Water and Sewer Rate
  Adjustment.

  Carla Gilhuys spoke in opposition to proposed water and sewer rate adjustments as
  presented in the City’s Notice of Public Hearing on Proposed Water and Sewer Rate
  Adjustment.

  Victor Clement requested clarification regarding the cost of the proposed emergency
  repairs.

  Al Reyes spoke in support of the proposed water and sewer rate adjustments as
  presented in the City’s Notice of Public Hearing on Proposed Water and Sewer Rate
  Adjustment.

  The Mayor announced that prior to the meeting, the Council members received full-text,
  unredacted copies of the one (1) written comment submitted for Item 5A, by the
  deadline listed on the agenda and for inclusion in the official record. Requests for copies
  of the written comment submitted for this meeting can be made during regular business
  hours to the Office of the City Clerk.

  Seeing no further speakers, the Mayor declared the public comments period closed.

  CONSENSUS (Yokoyama): Directed the City Manager to establish a standing
  agenda report for City Council review and consideration of Swim/Fitness Center
  Rehabilitation - Boiler Replacement, Project No. 20201, to allow an opportunity for
  prompt action in the event of a mechanical failure before sufficient project funding is
  secured.

  MOTION: It was moved by Johnson, and seconded by Hong, to:

  1. Authorize the City Manager to execute an amendment to the contract with General
  Pump Company, for Annual On-call Maintenance and Repair Services for Water
  Wells, Booster Pump Assemblies, and Gear Drives, Bid No. 1528-23;

  2. Authorize a budget transfer in the amount of $643,000 to the C-4 Well Emergency
  Repair by transferring funds from the Swim/Fitness Center Rehabilitation, Project
  No. 20201; and

  3. Authorize a budget transfer in the amount of $2,090,000 to Account No. 110-363-
  67020 Metropolitan Water District (MWD) Purchase for the additional, anticipated
  import water costs from:

  a.  110-363-65213 Water Well Pumping Assessment ($576,000);
  b.  Swim/Fitness Center Rehabilitation, Project No. 20201 ($457,000);
  c.  Annual Arterial Street Rehabilitation, Project No. 23303 ($649,000); and
  d.  Annual Sidewalk, Curb, & Gutter Rehabilitation, Project No. 13054 ($408,000)

  ; (COUNCIL).

  The meeting adjourned at 10:26 p.m.
